scope: pycallgraph.py whole read and pinned blob verified; original AST helpers tested with synthetic frames, no import side effects or process tracing

control_result.scope: Exact AST tracer and DOT helper; synthetic frames/module resolution/clock, no sys tracing, filesystem, renderer or monkeypatch of inspect

findings: Function identity uses module/class/co_name only, omitting filename/definition line/code identity. Two different code locations named work in one module merge into one count2 node; reproduced with synthetic frames.
get_dot(stop=True) ignores stop parameter. Stop spy receives zero calls; reproduced. get_gdf has same unused argument by source inspection.
Module import globally replaces inspect.getmodule with an unbounded memoizing wrapper without restoration. Not imported as a full module in control.
start/stop_trace overwrite sys tracing rather than preserve earlier handler; global stack/maps are not thread-local. No real hooks enabled or multithread claim tested.
Time totals are inclusive elapsed intervals from time.time and can include nested calls; graph colors normalize to largest node, not total CPU fraction.
is_module_stdlib uses lowercase string prefix rather than normalized component containment. Static finding, not a dedup file-path policy implementation.
Graph renderer builds a single unquoted os.system command; ordinary paths containing whitespace may be split. No command execution or renderer test.
Source declares GPL version2 or later; root MIT metadata does not authorize copying this nested module under MIT. No implementation copied.
